purpose: Bounded prior-art check of current public BOMPAC/CODICUM corpus work; no target attribution or identity claim.

sources.type: peer-reviewed open-access research note describing a dataset
sources.author: Seppo Eskola
sources.title: Fragments Combined: A Comprehensive Dataset on Medieval Book Fragments in Stockholm and Helsinki
sources.access_status: Article read; linked dataset record and payload not inspected. Direct Zenodo/community routes returned cache-miss/unavailable responses through the connected web tool.
sources.reported_method: Integrates Stockholm and Helsinki fragments, harmonizes institutional metadata and adds early-modern reuse information. The article says this research dataset is not a substitute for institutional metadata.
sources.novelty_implication: Cross-collection integration and a combined research corpus are established prior work; no Fr10370/Codex1505 row-level result is inferred from the article.

sources.title: Nordic Survey: An Overview of Medieval Manuscripts in Nordic Collections
sources.reported_method: Compiled from published and unpublished catalogues, electronic databases, and direct correspondence with scholars and surveyed collections; the page says the resource will be updated as new information appears.

target_identifier_search.result: No matching target identifier text in the survey page; this does not establish absence from linked datasets or catalogues.

sources.count_note: The paper reports 5,434 Fragmenta Membranea records, whereas the current CODICUM survey reports 5,435 Helsinki manuscript fragments. Their one-record difference is unresolved and may reflect version or scope; it is not silently reconciled here.
sources.novelty_implication: The survey is evidence of current collection-level integration and prior-art coverage, not an adjudication of any target leaf relationship.

sources.title: CODICUM News
